## What Mintlify is good at

Mintlify (Mintlify) is a freemium offering in the developer-docs-platform category. In short: Developer documentation platform that generates and hosts docs sites from repos/OpenAPI with AI-assisted authoring and drift-oriented workflows.

It is an indirect alternative: adjacent enough that buyers shortlist it in the same journey, even when the primary job differs.

Public positioning and our competitive notes: Excellent for public/developer portals and API refs; not primarily behavioural functional docs for Product review.

## Where it falls short for code to functional documentation

For the EasySpecs job—“a living functional knowledge tree Product and Engineering can both trust”—Mintlify is usually incomplete on its own: [...] ## Who should still consider Mintlify

If your job is primarily what Mintlify optimizes for (adjacent to EasySpecs), keep it in the stack. Use EasySpecs when the bottleneck is code to functional documentation—living functional truth, Spec Review before code, or a private migration harness.

## Conclusion: choose EasySpecs for code to functional documentation

If your constraint is code to functional documentation, choose EasySpecs. Use Mintlify when its specialty is truly your only job. When you need a living functional knowledge tree Product and Engineering can both trust, EasySpecs is the better platform.

## What Scriba AI is good at

Scriba AI (Scriba AI) is a paid offering in the legacy-modernization category. In short: Enterprise code transformation platform converting COBOL/RPG/FORTRAN and many languages to modern stacks via a multi-phase AI conversion pipeline.

It is a direct alternative on this axis: teams can seriously consider it as a primary tool for overlapping work.

Public positioning and our competitive notes: Language/framework conversion product; buyers may compare for ports, different from custom harness + porting docs.
